notes: All 400 frozen manifest ids resolve against the local verified_400 dataset.json; the partition is used unchanged.
Pinned to variant 'verified_400'. SkillGen's own SpreadsheetBench adapter defaults to 'full_912' -- a driver must force this variant.

5 of the 400 task directories (13284, 32023, 32789, 56274, 58109) use the bare 'initial.xlsx'/'golden.xlsx' naming instead of '1_<id>_init.xlsx'/'1_<id>_golden.xlsx'. SkillOpt's own test-case discovery already handles both, and this adapter delegates to it rather than encoding a second layout rule.
Default manifest only -- the run-time split is whatever manifest the launcher was given. This default covers the whole verified_400 population.

Each verified_400 task carries exactly one test case, so the official 'hard' metric (all cases must pass) reduces to per-task pass/fail on this variant; the upstream 912-task variant has three cases per task.

role_map.native_splits: none -- verified_400 is a flat 400-task dataset.json

official_scorer.note: SkillOpt's module is a documented faithful port; it is the only cell-value evaluator in this workspace.
